description: Land Title Settlement Department - Notice calling for claims to Land Parcels Akarahediya, Laggala D/S Divisiobn, Mathale District  - Cad. Map No. 310243 and others
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land-related matters, specifically calling for claims to land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It deals with land ownership claims, cadastral maps, and title settlement procedures for specific land parcels in Mathale and Kurunegala districts. The content focuses entirely on land registration and title determination processes without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other non-land administrative matters.
